latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Change Words:

- Instantly replace spoken or on-screen words in existing videos without re-recording.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB, delivering 1080p MP4 outputs.
- Fast, cloud-based processing (typically 30–60 seconds); tracks credits and session state.
- Easy workflows for quick edits, iterative changes, or batch processing.
- User-friendly: upload, specify word changes, and download the edited video—no technical steps needed.
